headline: Coca-Cola and PepsiCo Both Saw the Health Trend Coming. Only One of Them Actually Got Ahead of It.
summary: Coca-Cola and PepsiCo are taking very different paths through the health-conscious-beverage boom, and one is pulling away in a big way.
